environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 Lambda handler deployed via SAM template. The Lambda execution role has a broad DynamoDB policy: Effect=Allow, Action=[dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:PutItem], Resource=arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/UserDocuments. No IAM condition keys are applied. API Gateway uses Cognito authorizer passing JWT sub claim but no additional authorization logic exists. The table has partition key 'documentId' (String) and attribute 'ownerId' (String) but no application code checks ownership.
